about_the_game:
This is a free demo version of Vínculo, an indie 2.5D exploration game with a unique and original twist.

What does this demo offer?

During the trial, you can freely explore the first part of the map: the exterior of the Marble Palace. During your journey, you will fight enemies, discover hidden objects and chests, and meet some of the NPCs in this game, although you will not be able to complete their questlines. The demo version of the game won't allow you to face any of the bossfights.

Gameplay and mechanics:

  • A classic adventure with 2D movement but with a twist: travel through the third dimension thanks to the plane-shifting mechanic. Explore the palace on all axes!

  • Smooth movement and satisfying 2D platforming.

  • Use different platforming mechanics, such as aerial boosts, double jumps, and your own scarf-hook!

  • Meet several friendly (and not so friendly) characters.

  • A beautiful soundtrack, composed by the Canarian group Macaca Radiata, will accompany you every step of the way.

short_description: Embark yourself on an adventure through the Marble Palace and uncover the plentiful secrets it hides! Explore magnificent views and fight through the hostile halls of the palace, all while making use of the innovative plane change mechanics! - This version is a demo of the full game.
